text:
elaine: Quick follow-up to the 'stablepoint' idea in the RFC — do we have a recommended client contract for read-after-write in active/active when a write is tagged data_residency=EU? My concern is the tradeoff between snapshot emission frequency and tail latency for reads. RFC link: https://rfd.redwood/stablepoints

ben: We sketched emitting stablepoint markers from the primary commit pipeline. Rough numbers we discussed were 250ms to 1s intervals, but 250ms was optimistic under load. Not locked in yet.

samir: Implementation contract proposal: clients can request ?read_consistency=stablepoint&min_ts=<unix_ms>. If min_ts <= latest_stablepoint_ts returned by shard, serve locally with strong guarantee. Otherwise respond with 412 + latest_stablepoint_ts or fall back to eventual. Lightweight and explicit.

rachel: Ops note: more frequent markers increase metadata churn to control plane (lease metadata + metrics). We need a worst-case control-plane qps estimate before picking a default. Suggest opt-in per-tenant to start.

luca: Engineering constraints: two pieces required — (1) marker generation in commit path (cheap append-only marker stream), (2) a fast-path read handler that checks stablepoint_ts from local KV header before falling back to cross-region read. Both are doable but need perf validation.

ogata: Proposal refinement: default stablepoint interval = 1s, Dedicated customers can set 500ms, Private installs can configure as needed. Also expose a telemetry gauge for marker lag.

elaine: Actionable next steps: ben -> perf-run marker gen on staging (measure CPU + latency); rachel -> model control-plane cost (worst-case qps); samir -> draft client API + response codes. Can we aim to decide by EOD Friday?

ben: I can run perf tomorrow and attach flamegraph + p95 latency deltas.

rachel: I'll run cost model today and add a 99th percentile metadata write projection.

samir: Starting API draft now, will open PR mid-week with examples and a small compatibility note for existing clients.

opsbot: deploybot: canary job queued for branch 'stablepoint/stage' — 4/6 workers. Logs: https://ci.redwood/job/12345

elaine: Thanks — quick decision rule: if perf shows <10% control-plane overhead and local read p99 increases <5ms, proceed with default 500ms; otherwise default to 1s and revisit after optimization. cc @product
